name: Eventin Addon for TutorLMS
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Eventin for Tutor LMS connects your event management workflow directly to your eLearning platform, so you can sell tickets, manage registrations, and deliver live classes without leaving your LMS.

If you run online courses with Tutor LMS and deliver live sessions, workshops, webinars, or instructor-led training through Eventin, this addon closes the gap between the two. Students enroll in a course, get linked to the associated live event, and receive their ticket — all in a single flow. No manual data entry, no third-party workarounds.

For eLearning academies, corporate trainers, and independent course creators, this means one unified platform for both on-demand course content and real-time live events. Same enrollment data, same checkout, and a tighter student experience from registration through attendance.

Support 👇

👉 For support and issues? Contact Us Here

Key Features

  • Course-to-Event Linking – Attach Eventin events to any Tutor LMS course. Students who enroll are automatically connected to the linked live session or webinar.
  • Ticket Sales Inside Your LMS – Create ticket variations tied to your course pricing tiers and sell access to live classes directly from the course page.
  • Single-Step Registration – Students register for a course and its linked event in one flow, reducing drop-off and manual follow-up.
  • Real-Time Seat Availability – Show live seat counts and registration deadlines on course pages.
  • No Code Required – Link events to courses, configure tickets, and publish entirely from the WordPress admin.
  • Responsive Design – All event displays and registration components work across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • Theme Compatible – Inherits your active WordPress theme’s styling with no visual conflicts.

Who This Is For

Online Course Creators – Pair self-paced courses with scheduled live Q&A sessions, workshops, and webinars under one enrollment.

eLearning Academies & Institutes – Run cohort-based programs combining structured course content with a live class schedule.

Corporate Trainers – Build blended learning programs with on-demand modules and live instructor-led training sessions.

Webinar & Virtual Event Hosts – Connect webinars and virtual summits to related Tutor LMS courses so attendees enroll as part of event registration.

Coaches & Independent Tutors – Let students book live sessions directly from your course page without a separate booking tool.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate Eventin, Tutor LMS, and this addon
  2. Create your event inside Eventin as normal
  3. Open any Tutor LMS course in the editor
  4. Create ticket variations based on your course pricing
  5. Link the ticket variation(s) to the course
  6. Publish — students can now register for the event and enroll in one step

Requirements

  • Eventin – free, required
  • Tutor LMS – free, required

Extend With Eventin Pro

All core features work with the free version of Eventin. Eventin Pro adds:

  • AI Event Creator – Generate event descriptions, FAQs, and banners in seconds
  • Recurring Events – Schedule daily, weekly, or monthly live classes
  • Advanced Analytics – Track registrations, ticket sales, and attendee data
  • Ticket Template Builder – Issue branded PDF tickets to enrolled students
  • Landing Page Builder – Dedicated event pages with pre-built templates
  • Multi-language Support – Full translation support for global student audiences

View Eventin Pro Plans
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/eventin-addon-for-tutor-lms, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure both Eventin and Tutor LMS are installed and activated.
  4. Open any Tutor LMS course and use the Eventin event linking options to connect an event.
  5. Configure ticket variations and publish.
sections.faq:
Do I need both Eventin and Tutor LMS installed?

Yes. Both Eventin and Tutor LMS must be installed and activated for this addon to function.

Is this addon free?

Yes, completely free. Features that depend on Eventin Pro functionality require an active Eventin Pro license.

Can I link events to any Tutor LMS course?

Yes. You can link Eventin events to any Tutor LMS course and display event details, registration forms, or ticket listings on the course page.

Will it work with my existing theme?

Yes. The addon inherits your active WordPress theme’s styling and is compatible with any Tutor LMS-compatible theme.

Can I use it with the free version of Eventin?

Yes. All core features work with the free version of Eventin. Advanced features require an Eventin Pro license.

Is it compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes. This addon is tested and compatible with WordPress 6.8 and the latest version of Tutor LMS.
